declarations.name: RegularTable
declarations.summary: Viewport-virtualized table over serializable record rows.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Column keys or {key, label, cell} definitions.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Record rows held in the browser and sliced per viewport.

attributes.name: rowPatch
attributes.description: Serializable batch of update, insert, and remove row operations.

attributes.name: streamUrl
attributes.description: Optional SSE endpoint whose messages are row patches.

attributes.name: rowHeader
attributes.description: Optional row field rendered as a sticky row header.

attributes.name: rowHeight
attributes.description: Optional fixed row height in pixels.

events.name: cell-click
events.description: Clicked cell metadata and source row.

events.name: row-stream-error
events.description: An SSE message was not a valid row patch.

events.name: viewport-change
events.description: Visible geometry changed after a draw or internal scroll; coalesced per animation frame.

events.name: table-draw
events.description: Fires after each viewport draw so visible cells can be decorated.

members.name: updateRow
members.description: Merge fields into one row and redraw the viewport.

members.name: insertRow
members.description: Insert one row at a virtual index and redraw the viewport.

members.name: removeRow
members.description: Remove one row at a virtual index and redraw the viewport.

members.name: getRowAtPoint
members.description: Return the virtual row index at viewport coordinates, or undefined.

members.name: getCellAtPoint
members.description: Return body cell or row-header metadata at viewport coordinates, or undefined.

members.name: getRowBounds
members.description: Return full and clipped bounds for a rendered virtual row index, or undefined.

members.name: getCellBounds
members.description: Return full and clipped bounds for a rendered virtual row index and column key, or undefined.

members.name: getMeta
members.description: Resolve a rendered cell to virtual coordinates and its source row.
